node.title: Re^3: IO::Socket tutorial
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I don't even remember what got me thinking that IO::Socket's can be used as file descriptors

Technically they can be used like handles (not descriptors), they're subclasses of [doc://IO::Handle]. But as you discovered, doing a [doc://readline] on them is blocking; from my experience I very much prefer non-blocking operations, and those are IMHO best abstracted via an event-based interface.

In terms of example code, I should have been more specific: a [id://1177642].
